# Project Scaffold

Create the following project files:

- `src/main/java/com/example/App.java`
- `.gitignore`

In `App.java`, define the `com.example` package and an `App` class with:

- A public static `add` method that accepts two integers and returns their sum.
- A `main` method that serves as the application entry point.

Set `.gitignore` to ignore:

```gitignore
target/
.idea/
*.class
